units.source_text: 正因为我们之间有着这样的过往，所以‘在精神上没有上进心的人，是蠢货’这句话，必然会深深地刺痛K的心。

en.t: Because such a past lay between us, the words, "A person with no spiritual ambition is a fool," must have pierced K deeply.

units.source_text: 但是，正如我前面说过的，我并非企图通过这句话毁掉他多年来千辛万苦铸就的信念，

en.t: But, as I said before, I was not trying to destroy with those words the conviction he had built through years of hardship.

units.source_text: 相反，我是希望他像以前一样继续磨砺下去。

en.t: On the contrary, I wanted him to keep tempering himself as he had before.

units.source_text: 无论他成就道义也好，出人头地也罢，我都不关心。

en.t: Whether he fulfilled some moral ideal or rose in the world, I did not care.

units.source_text: 我只是担心他突然改变生活轨道，与我的利益发生冲突。

en.t: I only feared that he would suddenly change the course of his life and come into conflict with my interests.

units.source_text: 归根结底，我说这句话无非是私心在作怪。

en.t: In the end, I said those words for no reason other than selfishness.

units.source_text: ‘在精神上没有上进心的人，是蠢货。’

en.t: "A person with no spiritual ambition is a fool."

units.source_text: 我又重复了一遍这句话，然后仔细观察这句话会对K产生怎样的影响。

en.t: I repeated the words once more, then watched closely to see what effect they would have on K.
"A fool," he answered after a short while,

units.source_text: 他忽然站住，不往前走了，他低头盯着地面。

en.t: He suddenly stopped and would not go on; he lowered his head and stared at the ground.

units.source_text: 我不禁打了个冷战，恍惚感到K在那一瞬间，突然孤注一掷般强硬起来。

en.t: I could not help shuddering, dimly feeling that in that instant K had suddenly hardened with desperate resolve.

units.source_text: 但我还是听出他的声音有多么无力。

en.t: Even so, I could hear how powerless his voice was.

units.source_text: 我想再从他的眼睛里窥探点什么，可他一直没有正视我的眼睛。

en.t: I wanted to read something more from his eyes, but he never looked me straight in the eye.

units.source_text: 然后，他又步履沉重地走了起来。

en.t: Then he began walking again with heavy steps.
